verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers generic transaction creation and nexus declaration APIs, but nothing addresses marketplace-facilitator-specific handling (e.g., flagging facilitator-collected tax so it's tracked for nexus/reporting without being re-remitted). This is a well-known real AvaTax feature area, but no citation here documents it. missing for 10: marketplace facilitator transaction flagging/parameters, nexus tracking that excludes facilitator-collected tax from remittance, any documentation of Amazon/app-store facilitator scenarios.
